answer: One concrete defense is a stake-bonded reputation that accrues slowly, like a river carving its bed over time rather than a zephyr that passes in an hour. Each agent locks a refundable bond to join, and influence grows only through verified work. A sybil attacker must fund a separate bond for every fake identity, so a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds, and any detected cheating slashes the bond like a flawed opal losing its value. Scale becomes expensive, not free.
